title: Visa saisonnier, travailleur temporaire or salarié: which one is yours
shortAnswer: Short answer: your contract decides the visa. A seasonal contract gives you the visa saisonnier (6 months a year in France at most). A fixed-term contract of 6 to 12 months gives you the visa travailleur temporaire. A permanent contract (CDI) gives you the visa salarié. Only the last two let you stay and renew in France without going back to your country.

blocks.text: Which one is better for me?

items: If you want to work a few months and go back home: saisonnier. Ideal for agriculture, grape harvests, tourism and ski resorts.
If you have an offer of 6 to 12 months: travailleur temporaire. You can renew it if the contract is extended.
If you want to settle in France: salarié with a CDI. It is the most stable route to the carte pluriannuelle and, later on, the carte de résident.

blocks.text: In all three cases, the employer applies for the autorisation de travail first and you then apply for the visa at the consulate. One thing to watch: renewing the titre salarié and travailleur temporaire is not done through ANEF, but directly with the préfecture. Every case is individual, so always check with the préfecture where you live.
What's new: the métiers en tension

France publishes a list of occupations with labor shortages, region by region (the current one comes from the arrêté of 21 May 2025). If your job is on that list, the employer does not have to prove they looked for a candidate in France first, which makes the autorisation de travail easier. Construction, hospitality, agriculture and healthcare appear on it often.

items.question: Can I switch from saisonnier to salarié without leaving France?
items.answer: No. The carte saisonnier does not allow a change of status: you need a new visa from the consulate.

items.question: How long does the autorisation de travail take?
items.answer: It depends on the platform and the region; count on several weeks. That is why it pays to start early.

items.question: Can my partner come with me?
items.answer: There is no family reunification with the carte saisonnier. With salarié it is possible later on, under certain conditions.
